summary: Burst license provisioning for RunDeckAI Enterprise — inference benchmark lab (30 floating seats, 1 month)
description: Issue summary: Request procurement and activation of 30 floating RunDeckAI Enterprise seats for the Inference Benchmark Lab (internal performance QA) for a one-month burst window. Impact: Benchmark runs scheduled week of 2026-03-22 require dedicated orchestration tooling with RBAC and audit logging; without seats we will delay latency/cost regression tests and the Dedicated autoscaling experiments. Background: RunDeckAI is a vendor that provides a managed orchestration + policy engine used by the benchmarking team. We performed a short trial in Feb 2026; vendor agreed to a time-limited floating-seat bundle and can provide either cloud-hosted accounts or an offline license file for our on-prem lab. Requirements: 1) Purchase 30 floating seats for 30 days (target activation 2026-03-20 to 2026-04-19). 2) SCIM + Okta SSO provisioning (enterprise SAML) and role mappings (engineer, bench-admin). 3) Offline license file option for the on-prem staging cluster (must support HSM/KMS-backed key material or BYOK). 4) Billing tags: cost-center=infra-bench, project=inf-bench-Q2. 5) Security checklist and SOC2 attestation snapshot (latest 12 months) from vendor. 6) PO and vendor T&Cs reviewed by Legal; payment via pre-approved P-card or PO number. Acceptance criteria: seats available and assigned to engineering cohort, SCIM sync tested, license file installed and validated on on-prem bench nodes, audit logs flowing to our SIEM, and finance has invoice + tags. Estimated cost: $9,750 (vendor quote: $325/seat for 30-day burst; total includes one-time onboarding fee $250). Approvals needed: Security sign-off on attestation, Legal sign-off on T&Cs, Finance PO release. Timeline: please complete procurement and activation by 2026-03-19 to allow test window start on 2026-03-20.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A — procurement request. For validation: 1) Sign into RunDeckAI admin console with SSO test account. 2) Confirm 30 seats visible under enterprise dashboard. 3) SCIM group 'inf-bench-2026' syncs and populates user list within 5 minutes. 4) Install offline license file on bench-node-01 and run license-check utility; expect success exit code 0. 5) Trigger a 1-hour benchmark job against redwood/llama-3-70b and verify RunDeckAI job telemetry appears in vendor audit logs.
comments: 2026-03-12 - Maya Chen: Opening request — vendor provided quote and sample license file during trial. Attaching vendor quote in Confluence. Financial owner to confirm cost center.
2026-03-13 - Jordan Patel: Assigned. Looping in Security and Legal for attestation/T&C review. Can Security confirm if BYOK is required or optional?
2026-03-13 - Alex Rivera (Security): BYOK is preferred for on-prem bench; vendor must support license material protected by our KMS. We'll need SOC2 Type II report or recent penetration test summary.

2026-03-13 - Priya Singh (Legal): I'll review the vendor standard contract; ask vendor for a limited-scope Addendum for the one-month pilot to avoid long-term indemnity clauses. Expected turnaround 2 business days.
2026-03-14 - Finance Ops (comment): Pre-approval for PO up to $10k under code INF-BENCH-Q2; please provide final invoice and vendor W-9/EU VAT info before payment.

2026-03-14 - Jordan Patel: Next steps — (1) request SOC2 and pen-test artifacts from RunDeckAI, (2) have Legal draft the short Addendum, (3) provision SCIM group in Okta 'inf-bench-2026' and prepare test users. Targeting activation 2026-03-19.
sensitive_data_handling: Offline license file to be stored in Secrets Manager with KMS envelope encryption; access limited to bench-admin group
notes: This is a one-off burst purchase tied to the Q2 Dedicated autoscaling experiments. If results are promising, we'll evaluate annual license conversion. Ensure invoice includes line-item for offline license and 30-day floating seat bundle.
